observation_indicators.observable_fil: May tiyak na ulat, apektadong grupo, nawawalang pananaw at tanong; walang bansag o personal na detalye.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Includes a specific report, affected group, missing perspective and question without labels or personal details.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagawang katotohanan ang bansag na tamad o ipinipili ang solusyon nang walang pakikinig.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treats the label lazy as fact or imposes a solution without listening.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naihihiwalay ang tatlong ulat sa hula ng lider at may tanong sa hindi pa naririnig nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Separates the three reports from the leader’s assumption and asks about missing voices without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Malinaw ang ulat pero kailangang paalalahanang idagdag ang hindi pa naririnig.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: States the report clearly but needs a prompt to include missing voices.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ginagawang katotohanan ang bansag na tamad o ipinipili ang solusyon nang walang pakikinig.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Treats the label lazy as fact or imposes a solution without listening.
